cat > /workspace/.build-logs/patch_dockerfile.py <<'PYEOF'
import re, sys, os

# usage: patch_dockerfile.py <stage_dir>
# 1) For each build stage that runs `uv sync`/`uv lock` WITHOUT a full-context
#    `COPY .` BEFORE its first uv command, insert `COPY . <WORKDIR>/` right after
#    the stage's first WORKDIR (adds `--chown=<user>` when the stage runs as a
#    non-root user, so the build user can write into the copied tree).
stage = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1])
df = os.path.join(stage, 'Dockerfile')
if not os.path.isfile(df):
    print("no Dockerfile", stage); sys.exit(0)
lines = open(df).read().splitlines(keepends=True)

from_re    = re.compile(r'^\s*FROM\s')
workdir_re = re.compile(r'^\s*WORKDIR\s+(\S+)')
user_re    = re.compile(r'^\s*USER\s+(\S+)')
fullcopy_re= re.compile(r'^\s*COPY\s+\.(\s|$)')
uv_re      = re.compile(r'\buv\s+(sync|lock)\b')

stages, cur = [], None
for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
    if from_re.match(ln):
        cur = [i, []]
        stages.append(cur)
    if cur is not None:
        cur[1].append(ln)

insertions = {}
patched = 0
for start_idx, slines in stages:
    if not any(uv_re.search(l) for l in slines):
        continue
    workdir = '/app'
    user = None
    first_workdir_idx = None
    full_before_uv = False
    seen_uv = False
    for j, l in enumerate(slines):
        m = workdir_re.match(l)
        if m and first_workdir_idx is None:
            workdir = m.group(1)
            first_workdir_idx = j
        u = user_re.match(l)
        if u and not seen_uv:
            user = u.group(1)
        if not seen_uv and fullcopy_re.match(l):
            full_before_uv = True
        if not seen_uv and uv_re.search(l):
            seen_uv = True
    if full_before_uv or first_workdir_idx is None:
        continue
    chown = f" --chown={user}:{user}" if (user and user not in ('root', '0')) else ""
    insertions[start_idx + first_workdir_idx] = f"COPY{chown} . {workdir}/\n"
    patched += 1

if insertions:
    out = []
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        out.append(l)
        if i in insertions:
            out.append(insertions[i])
    open(df, 'w').writelines(out)

print(f"patched {patched} stage(s) in {df}")
PYEOF
# test chown detection on berichtskonfigurator
rm -rf /tmp/pt3 && cp -r /workspace/.build-logs/stage/berichtskonfigurator /tmp/pt3
docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w -v /tmp/pt3:/pt ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm python3 /w/.build-logs/patch_dockerfile.py /pt
grep -n 'chown\|COPY . ' /tmp/pt3/Dockerfile | head -6; rm -rf /tmp/pt3
